headline.title: Health by Science in Leith takes bookings from 6am to 10pm, seven days a week. You close at 3–4pm on Mondays and Fridays.
headline.detail: In our search for physiotherapy in Portobello your own site appeared, which is a strong start. But people choosing at 8pm or on a Sunday see the clinics that are open, and Leith has two with long hours and strong reviews.

summary: The Physiotherapy Place is one of the best-reviewed physios in east Edinburgh: 241 five-star reviews in Portobello and 146 in Musselburgh. The risk is the hours race: Leith clinics open from 6–7am until 8–10pm, and patients who can only come after work or at weekends drift towards them.

search.result: A Fresha directory page came first, then WhatClinic, then your own site and booking page. Fresha and WhatClinic list other clinics next to you.
search.meaning: You are found, but the first thing many people see is a directory that offers them alternatives.

visibility: In our search for physiotherapy in Portobello your own site appeared near the top, a great position. The first result, though, was a directory page that lists other clinics alongside you.
lead: 241 five-star reviews in Portobello and 146 in Musselburgh.
Two seaside locations and strong support for runners.
Patients who had bad experiences elsewhere say they finally felt safe.
lose: Leith clinics take bookings until 8–10pm and on Sundays; you close at 3–4pm on Mondays and Fridays.
The first search result is a directory that shows patients other options before you.
One review mentions two price rises, so value needs explaining clearly.

gaps.title: After-work patients go to Leith
gaps.detail: People who can only come after 6pm or at weekends find clinics that are open, and book there.

gaps.title: Directories sit between you and patients
gaps.detail: When Fresha or WhatClinic comes first, patients compare you with others before they ever reach your page.

gaps.title: Your two clinics aren't working together online
gaps.detail: Musselburgh and Portobello each have strong reviews, but a patient searching one area rarely learns about the other.

actions.title: Make evening and Saturday slots easy to find and book
actions.why: Even a few later slots, clearly bookable online, stop after-work patients drifting to Leith.

actions.title: Ask every patient for a review automatically
actions.why: Keeps you ahead as Leith clinics grow their reviews.

actions.title: Show both locations on your Google profiles
actions.why: Doable today: link Portobello and Musselburgh so each one sends patients to the other.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your team, specialties and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each visit, so happy patients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Reminders and recall
plan.detail: Follow-up and maintenance reminders that go out by themselves.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against nearby clinics, and what to do next.

scenario: A teacher in Joppa hurts her knee on Saturday's parkrun. On Sunday evening she searches "physio near me", sees you closed, and finds a Leith clinic taking bookings until 10pm. She books for Monday at 7am and becomes their patient. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your reviews stay excellent, but patients who need early, late or weekend appointments keep finding clinics in Leith. Over time those clinics catch up on reviews too.
